description: The Open Database of Buildings is a harmonised collection of building footprints from open government data in Canada, compiled by Statistics Canada in its Linkable Open Data Environment. It brings together 530 datasets from 107 municipal, regional, provincial and federal sources. Version 3.0, released on 15 April 2025, holds about 14.4 million records for the provinces and territories where open building features were found between November 2024 and April 2025. Coverage: parts of Canada where governments publish open building data, so rural and some regional areas may be missing. Access: zipped GeoPackage files per province or territory, with a metadata document on concepts, methodology and data quality, and a record on the Open Government Portal. Licence: Open Government Licence - Canada; free. Caveats: attributes and capture dates vary with each source dataset, and completeness depends on what local governments publish. Simulation uses are a national base of building footprints for flood, wildfire and earthquake exposure and for building stock energy models. Related records: the Open Database of Educational Facilities and the Microsoft building footprint records.
